I have completed a full source-fidelity and internal-consistency review of the entire patent application draft, including all claims, the detailed description, the reference numeral list, and all figure briefs. Every limitation in every claim, every numbered part, and every specific structure, relationship, and variant described in the application text and figure briefs was traced to an affirmative statement in the inventor's disclosure and conversation files. The draft is almost entirely source-faithful and internally consistent, but one minor internal logic issue was found in the figure briefs. Several briefs for overview figures describe numbered parts as "unnumbered," which creates an inconsistency with the numeral list and the briefs for the detail views where those parts are properly identified. A finding has been raised to correct this for clarity and consistency.
